def comps(g):
    seen=set(); out=[]
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:
                c=g[i][j]; q=deque([(i,j)]); seen.add((i,j)); cells=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy in(-1,0,1):
                        for dx in(-1,0,1):
                            ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                            if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and g[ny][nx]==c and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                                seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
                out.append((c,cells))
    return out

def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    O=[r[:] for r in g]
    for c,cells in comps(g):
        rs=[a for a,b in cells]; cs=[b for a,b in cells]
        minr,minc=min(rs),min(cs); h=max(rs)-minr+1; w=max(cs)-minc+1
        # full ring check: perimeter count
        perim=lambda: 4*(h-2)+4*(w-2) if h>1 and w>1 else 0
        n=len(cells)
        if n==perim():  # full ring
            newr=0
            for a,b in sorted(cells): O[a][b]=0
            for a,b in sorted(cells): O[newr+(a-minr)][b]=c
        else:
            newr=H-h
            for a,b in sorted(cells): O[a][b]=0
            for a,b in sorted(cells): O[newr+a-minr][b]=c
    return O

def comps(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0]);seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)];res=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j] and not seen[i][j]:
                col=g[i][j];c=[];q=deque([(i,j)]);seen[i][j]=True
                while q:
                    x,y=q.popleft();c.append((x,y))
                    for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
                        if 0<=nx<H and 0<=ny<W and g[nx][ny]==col and not seen[nx][ny]:
